description: Retrieves a list of distinct values for a specified tag key associated with an existing Sentry issue, useful for understanding tag manifestations like browser versions or affected users.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for fetching distinct values for a specified tag associated with a Sentry issue.

environment.description: A list of environment names to filter the tag values; if provided, only values from these specified environments will be returned.
environment.title: Environment

issue_id.description: The unique numerical identifier of the Sentry issue for which tag values are to be fetched.
issue_id.title: Issue Id

key.description: The specific tag key (e.g., 'browser', 'user_id', 'environment') for which to retrieve distinct values associated with the issue.
key.title: Key

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

sort.description: Sort order for tag values; valid options are 'age', 'count', 'date', 'id'. Prefix with '-' for descending (e.g., '-count'); defaults to '-id'.
sort.title: SortEnm

inputSchema.title: FetchTagValuesForIssueRequest

name: fetch_tag_values_for_issue

FetchTagValuesForIssueResponse.description: Response schema containing an array of tag values for the issue.
FetchTagValuesForIssueResponse.title: FetchTagValuesForIssueResponse

TagValue.description: Represents a distinct tag value with metadata for a Sentry issue.

count.description: Number of occurrences of this tag value
count.title: Count

firstSeen.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the initial occurrence (nullable)
firstSeen.title: First Seen

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the most recent occurrence (nullable)
lastSeen.title: Last Seen

name.description: Display name for the tag value
name.title: Name

query.description: Query string associated with the tag value (nullable)
query.title: Query

TagValue.title: TagValue
